facts.statement: Corvina SOW-2 has a contract value of €74k and a target start date of 12 October.
facts.whyItMatters: The start date and contract value must be confirmed in the draft SOW prior to engagement.

facts.statement: Bhavin plans to send a heads-up email regarding Kriti and sub-processor SyncRiver along with the SOW.
facts.quote: just sending the SOW + a heads-up email about Kriti and SyncRiver
facts.whyItMatters: An informal email notice may not meet legal requirements for sub-processor notification, particularly since the GDPR Art. 28 DPA is currently missing.

facts.statement: Tracker confirms SOW-2 requires sub-processor notice for adding Kriti and SyncRiver.
facts.quote: SYN-120 (SOW-2 + sub-processor notice): EUR 74k. start 12 Oct. adds Kriti + SyncRiver
facts.whyItMatters: Adding sub-processor SyncRiver requires proper contract coverage and formal client notice mechanisms under applicable privacy regulations.
